command: set -e; SDK="$HOME/Library/Android/sdk"; export ANDROID_SDK_ROOT="$SDK" ANDROID_HOME="$SDK" PATH="$SDK/platform-tools:$SDK/emulator:$PATH"; adb kill-server || true; pkill -f 'emulator.*medium_phone' || true; nohup "$SDK/emulator/emulator" -avd medium_phone -no-window -no-audio -no-boot-anim -gpu swiftshader_indirect -no-snapshot-save > /tmp/lcl-medium-phone-emulator.log 2>&1 & echo $! > /tmp/lcl-medium-phone-emulator.pid; for i in $(seq 1 120); do adb start-server >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; BOOT=$(adb shell getprop sys.boot_completed 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\r' || true); if [ "$BOOT" = "1" ]; then break; fi; if ! kill -0 "$(cat /tmp/lcl-medium-phone-emulator.pid)" 2>/dev/null; then echo 'EMULATOR_EXITED'; cat /tmp/lcl-medium-phone-emulator.log; exit 1; fi; sleep 2; done; test "$(adb shell getprop sys.boot_completed 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\r')" = "1"; printf 'ANDROID_RELEASE=%s API=%s ABI=%s\n' "$(adb shell getprop ro.build.version.release | tr -d '\r')" "$(adb shell getprop ro.build.version.sdk | tr -d '\r')" "$(adb shell getprop ro.product.cpu.abi | tr -d '\r')"; tail -80 /tmp/lcl-medium-phone-emulator.log
